name: Service request status
description: Open311 GeoReport v2 defines only open and closed, which loses the distinction residents most want: whether anyone has actually picked the request up. These terms refine that while staying mappable - anything other than closed, rejected, or duplicate maps to Open311 open.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Open
hasDefinedTerm.description: Received, not yet being worked on. Maps to Open311 open.

hasDefinedTerm.name: In progress
hasDefinedTerm.description: Assigned and being worked on. Maps to Open311 open.

hasDefinedTerm.name: On hold
hasDefinedTerm.description: Acknowledged but blocked, for example awaiting a contractor or a season. Maps to Open311 open.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Closed
hasDefinedTerm.description: Work completed. Maps to Open311 closed.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Rejected
hasDefinedTerm.description: Closed without action, for example outside the authority's remit. Maps to Open311 closed, but publishing the distinction is what stops a resident re-reporting the same thing.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Duplicate
hasDefinedTerm.description: Closed as already reported. Maps to Open311 closed.
